book.name: Yoan
book.title: Varu poia to Yoan imbooda Jon—John

content: Yesu pale ila igharaat ndug to nepooŋ pa tamtoghon toni
Yesu isaav pa taghoniiŋa toni ighaze: “Lolomim ipataŋan ve agham ŋgar naol malep. Aghur ila to Maaron, ve aghur inim tiou paam. Mbo 42:5; Mt 6:25; Pil 4:6+; 1Pe 5:7

Tamaŋ ruum toni, le sosoor katindi to nepooŋ. Inimale le sosoor katindi maau, tone irau nasaav payam tovene maau. You pale namuuŋ nala, ve nagharaat lemim inamim to nepooŋ izi tonowe. Ighaze nagharaata le isob, nene pale namuul nanim, ve nagham gham anim tiou. Leso aneep toman ghou izi ndug to you naneep pani. Yo 17:24; 2 Kor 5:1+; Hib 11:16; 1Tes 4:16+
Ataam to ndug to you naghaze nala pani, yam awatagi wa.”
Yesu inim ataam pait pa tala to Tama Maaron
Tomas ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve isaav pa Yesu ighaze: “Tiina, ndug to yom ughaze ula pani ne, yei nikankaan pani. Pale niwatag ataam to nila pa ndug tonanan vena?”

Yesu ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “You taug to ataam. You napatooŋ katin gham pa Maaron ve saveeŋ toni onoon, ve nanim pughu pa nepooŋ to mataad iyaryaar. Ataam ee moghon to tamtoghon titaghoni ve tila to Tamaŋ, nene you. Ite paam maau. Yo 10:9, 11:25; Ep 2:18; Hib 10:19+
Ighaze awatag katin ghou, nene pale awatag Tamaŋ paam. Aazne ve ila, yam awatagi. Pasa, aghita wa.” Yo 8:19
Tovenen Pilip isaav pani ighaze: “Tiina, upatooŋ Tamam payei, ghoro nighazooŋ pani ve atemai izi.”

Yesu isaav pani ighaze: “Wai Pilip, itiŋa takaria nepooŋ wa! Ve yom ughilaal ghou sone? Tamtoghon to ighaze ighita ghou, nene ighita Tamaŋ. Pughu vena to ughason ghou ughaze napatooŋ Tamaŋ payam? Yo 12:45; Kol 1:15; Hib 1:3

Yom ughur ila sone? You naneep ila to Tamaŋ, ve ye ineep inim tiou. Saveeŋ to you nasavia payam ne, nasavia itaghon taug ŋgar tiou maau. Tamaŋ to ineep inim tiou, tauto ighamgham uraat toni ila nimag. Yo 7:16+

You naneep ila to Tamaŋ, ve ye ineep inim tiou. Saveeŋ tonene, yam irau aghur ila. Ve ighaze aghur ila maau, ghoro agham ŋgar pa uraat tintina to you nagham di tivot wa. Leso ipalot gham, ve aghur inim tiou. Yo 5:36, 10:38

“Onoon kat, you nasaav payam: Ighaze tamtoghon eta ighur inim tiou, ye pale igham uraat tintina tinimale uraat to you naghamgham di. Ve ye pale igham uraat tintina pida paam le tilib pa uraat tiou. Pasa, you pale napul taan, ve namuul nala to Tamaŋ. Mk 16:16+; Mbaŋ 2:43, 5:12
Sa mbeb to ighaze yam aghason Tamaŋ Maaron pani ila you izag, nene pale you naghami ivot. Leso napaghazoŋan Tamaŋ iza tiina toman tapiri ve poia toni. Mt 7:7; Yo 15:7; 1Yo 3:22, 5:14
Tovenen sa mbeb to ighaze yam aghason pani ila you izag, nene pale you naghami.
Yesu pale imbaaŋ Avuvu Patabuaŋ izi inim
“Ighaze lolomim payou, nene pale matamim kisin tutuuŋ tiou, ve ataghon di. Yo 15:10+; 1Yo 2:3+
Ve you pale naghason Tamaŋ pa imbaaŋ Palotiiŋa ite paam izilat tiam. Leso ineep toman gham irau sawa isob, ve ipalot gham.

Palotiiŋa tonowen, nene Maaron Avuvu. Ye pale ipaghazoŋan gham pa saveeŋ onoon to Maaron. Pasa, ye isasavia saveeŋ onoon. Tamtoghon to titaghon taan ŋgara, yes irau tighami maau. Pasa, tighita maau, ve tiwatagi maau. Eemoghon yam, ghoro awatagi. Pasa, ye inepneep toman gham. Ve muri, ye pale ineep tuŋia ila lolomim. Yo 15:26, 16:7,13+; Mbaŋ 2:4; 1Kor 2:14
“You irau napul gham aneep sorok animale yes parooŋa ne maau. You pale namuul nanim tiam. Mt 28:20; Mbaŋ 2:4

Yes to titaghon taan ŋgara, mala maau pale tighita ghou muul maau. Eemoghon yam ghoro aghita ghou. Pasa, you pale namundig muul ve naneep matag iyaryaar. Tovenen yam paam pale agham nepooŋ poia inim tiou, ve aneep matamim iyaryaar.
Sawa tonenen, yam pale aghilaal aghaze you naneep ila to Tamaŋ, ve yam aneep inim tiou, ve you naneep ilat tiam. Iit tasob talup ghiit tanim ee moghon. Yo 17:21
Tamtoghon to ighaze mata kisin tutuuŋ tiou ve itaghon di, nene ye to lolo ineep. Tamtoghon tovene, nene pale Tamaŋ lolo ineep toni, ve you paam lolog ineep toni ve napatooŋ taug pani.” 1Yo 2:5, 5:3
Yesu isaav tovene, ve Yudas ite (ye Yudas Iskariot maau) ighasoni ighaze: “Tiina, vena to yom ughaze upatooŋ taum pa yei moghon, ve ival tiina to taan maau?”

Yesu ipamuul ghasoniiŋ toni tovene: “Ighaze tamtoghon eta lolo payou kat, nene pale mata kisin saveeŋ tiou ve itaghoni. Tamtoghon tovene, Tamaŋ pale lolo pani kat, ve yeru Tamaŋ nila toni, ve nighami inim inamai to nepooŋ. 1Kor 3:16; 2Kor 6:16; Syg 3:20

Eemoghon tamtoghon to ighaze lolo ineep tiou maau, nene pale lolo imaagh pa saveeŋ tiou, ve itaghoni maau. Saveeŋ to yam aloŋlooŋa, nene taug saveeŋ tiou maau. Nene Tamaŋ to imbaaŋ ghou nanim ne saveeŋ toni.
“Aazne, itiŋa tanepneep, ve nasavia saveeŋ tonene payam.

Eemoghon mala maau pale napul gham, ve Tamaŋ imbaaŋ lemim Palotiiŋa ite paam izilat pa you izag. Nene Avuvu Patabuaŋ. Ye pale igham naghog, ve ipaghazoŋan ŋgar tiam pa mbeb tisob, ve ipei ŋgar tiam pa saveeŋ isob to you nasavia payam. Leso matamim kisini. Lu 24:49; Yo 16:13; 1Yo 2:20,27

“You pale napul gham. Tovenen naghaze napul luuma tiou ineep toman gham, leso aneep poia toman lolomim luuma. Nepooŋ poia to naghaze nagham payam, nene raraate inimale nepooŋ poia to tamtoghon to taan tighamghami ne maau. Tovenen lolomim imbumbu malep, ve amatughez malep. Yo 16:33; Ro 5:1; Pil 4:7; Kol 3:15

Yam alooŋ ghou naghaze: ‘You pale napul gham, ve nala. Eemoghon muri, you pale namuul nanim tiam.’ Ighaze lolomim payou, nene pale lolomim poia ve tinimim iza. Pasa, Tamaŋ to ilib payou ne, you naghaze namuul nala toni.
Saveeŋ isob tonene, you nasavia payam pataghaaŋ. Leso sawa to anoŋa toni ivot, matamim iŋgal aliŋag, ve aghur inim tiou.
Saveeŋ to nasasavia payam ne, irau naseeŋga ila mala kat maau. Pasa, ŋginiiŋ to taan tonene inim igharau wa. Ye tapiri irau ghou maau, ve you naneep ila ye samba maau.

Eemoghon you irau nataghon katin saveeŋ isob to Tamaŋ isavia payou, ve pataŋani ivot payou itaghon ŋgar toni. Leso tamtoghon to taan tiwatag tighaze you lolog pa Tamaŋ kat. Yo, amundig tapul ndug tonene, ve tala.” Yo 10:18; Pil 2:8; Hib 5:8
